introduction.objective: Name how many equal parts make one whole.

learningGoals.objective: Count the equal parts in a whole.

skills.description: Count the equal parts in a whole.

tutorGuidance: This is a small authoring starter, not a complete researched lesson. Explain that the whole bar is split into equal parts. Invite the child to count them. Ask a small question and respond to their meaning. Use a different number of parts for a fresh try; introduce that task. Assess only currentAttempt after Check, never the draft. Correct a counting error specifically, allow revision, and offer a fresh try when helpful. Ask how they counted only when needed. Finish by asking how capable they feel. Do not require a fixed sequence. Use familiar words and one short question at a time.
